items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: I forget his name. Austin Wilson. Yeah, Austin Wilson. See, he was in this picture. This picture of Benny Goodman.

ctx.x: Ori's been gone for years. Yeah, but. Ori was a band leader. That's the difference.

Yeah, Ori was a band leader. Ori is a. Orgin. Oh, and I, well, he wrote nice tunes, you know. And the tunes that he wrote. Of course he played with him a long time. And then this movie actor put his arms around him in California and he was broadcasting, I forget his name. Austin Wilson. Yeah, Austin Wilson. See, he was in this picture. This picture of Benny Goodman. And so I mean when a man was before the public, see I quit for six years. And I never has been as popular as Ori and I admit it. But I don't think he…
You think Roy Palmer played more trombone than you?
